Module org.egothor.radixor
Package org.egothor.stemmer

Enum Class StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language>
org.egothor.stemmer.StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language>, Constable
Enclosing class:
StemmerPatchTrieLoader
public static enum StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language extends Enum<StemmerPatchTrieLoader.Language>
Supported language identities and their stable default model mappings.

Each language constant defines:

  • a deprecated legacy resource-directory name
  • the stable default model ID used by language-oriented loading
  • whether the language is written right-to-left

The right-to-left flag is orthographic metadata for presentation and user interface decisions. It does not select trie traversal: natural-language suffixes occupy the end of the stored character sequence in every supported script.

    • resourcePath

      @Deprecated(since="4.0.0", forRemoval=false) public String resourcePath()
      Deprecated.
      Returns the conventional resource path of this language's default model.

      Production loading resolves descriptors through StemmerModelRegistry; it does not use this method for discovery or selection.

      Returns:
      classpath resource path

    • defaultModelId

      public String defaultModelId()
      Returns the stable identifier selected by language-oriented loader methods.
      Returns:
      exact model ID, independent of classpath ordering

    • resourceDirectory

      public String resourceDirectory()
      Returns the resource directory name.
      Returns:

    • isRightToLeft

      public boolean isRightToLeft()
      Returns whether the language is written right-to-left.

      This flag describes writing direction only. It does not imply a WordTraversalDirection.

      Returns:
      true when the language is written right-to-left, otherwise false
